checks.text: The page heading is "Math Editor" and the tab labelled "Source" is active by default, showing the code area with the placeholder text "Type Markdown and TeX here".

Typing `# Title\n\nHello $x^2$ world` into the code area and waiting 500 ms shows the tab labelled "Preview" containing an `<h1>` with the text "Title" and a paragraph containing the text "Hello" followed by a rendered math element with the accessible text "x squared" and then the text "world".

Typing `| A | B |\n|---|---|\n| 1 | 2 |` into the code area shows in the Preview tab a table with two columns and two rows, where the first body cell contains "1" and the second body cell contains "2".

Typing `- [ ] Task one\n- [x] Task two` into the code area shows in the Preview tab a list with two items: the first item has an unchecked checkbox and the text "Task one", the second item has a checked checkbox and the text "Task two".

Clicking the button labelled "Copy Markdown" copies the exact text currently in the code area to the clipboard; with the code area containing `# Hi

$y$`, the clipboard content is `# Hi

$y$`.

Clicking the button labelled "Export HTML" downloads a file named `math-editor.html` whose content includes the string `

Hi

` when the code area contains `# Hi`.

Clicking the tab labelled "History" shows a list of saved snapshots; after typing `# First` and waiting for autosave (2 seconds), then typing `# Second` and waiting for autosave, the History tab shows two entries with the texts "First" and "Second".
In the History tab, clicking the button labelled "Restore" on the entry containing "First" changes the code area content to `# First` and the Preview tab shows an `<h1>` with the text "First".

Reload keeps the document: after typing `# Saved Doc` into the code area and waiting 2 seconds for autosave, reloading the page shows the code area containing `# Saved Doc` and the Preview tab showing an `<h1>` with the text "Saved Doc".
